note: Split because the file-transfer step caps at 20MB. app.js fetches the parts and concatenates them.
patched: Dynamic batch dimensions (-1) were rewritten to their concrete values in 107 tensors. LiteRT.js refuses a concrete input buffer against a dynamic shape signature, so the batch is now static at 1. Values were edited in place; no offsets moved.
runtime: @litertjs/core (tfjs-tflite is too old: its bundled interpreter aborts on this 2.15-converted model)

input.preprocess: resize/centre-crop to 299x299 and pass RAW 0-255 float values. NOT x/127.5-1: the Xception convention gives garbage here (top probability ~0.04, input-insensitive). Normalisation is baked into the graph. Verified against live photographs.

verified.runtime: @litertjs/core 2.5.3, accelerator wasm (webgpu errored on this model)
verified.outputs: probabilities, sum to 1.0 exactly — no softmax needed
verified.spotCheck: 8 species photographs: 6 exact top-1, 1 correct at rank 2 (crow vs raven), 1 miss (Anax junius -> another dragonfly)
